Specification: This module specifies and model checks a recursive mergesort algorithm translated from a PlusCal procedure into TLA+. It models sorting arrays of values in 1..N for all lengths up to ArrayLen, using an auxiliary buffer b and an explicit call stack to represent recursive procedure calls. The specification checks termination under weak fairness of Next and asserts a safety property that when the program counter reaches "Done", the array is sorted in nondecreasing order.
AssumptionNames: Print(<<"Testing Mergesort on all arrays of length <= ", ArrayLen>>, TRUE)
IfThenElse:
IF r - l > 0 THEN /\ m' = ((r + l) \div 2)
                 /\ pc' = "l2"
            ELSE /\ pc' = "l8"
                 /\ m' = m

IF i \geq l
            THEN /\ b' = [b EXCEPT ![i] = a[i]]
                 /\ i' = i - 1
                 /\ pc' = "l5"
                 /\ j' = j
            ELSE /\ IF m \geq l
                       THEN /\ i' = l
                       ELSE /\ PrintT("not sure of semantics of Pascal")
                            /\ i' = (CHOOSE x \in {} : FALSE)
                 /\ j' = m + 1
                 /\ pc' = "l6"
                 /\ b' = b

IF m \geq l
                       THEN /\ i' = l
                       ELSE /\ PrintT("not sure of semantics of Pascal")
                            /\ i' = (CHOOSE x \in {} : FALSE)

IF j \leq r
            THEN /\ b' = [b EXCEPT ![r + m + 1 - j] = a[j]]
                 /\ j' = j + 1
                 /\ pc' = "l6"
                 /\ UNCHANGED << i, k >>
            ELSE /\ IF m+1 \leq r
                       THEN /\ j' = r
                            /\ i' = i
                       ELSE /\ PrintT("not sure of semantics of Pascal")
                            /\ i' = (CHOOSE x \in {} : FALSE)
                            /\ j' = j
                 /\ k' = l
                 /\ pc' = "l7"
                 /\ b' = b

IF m+1 \leq r
                       THEN /\ j' = r
                            /\ i' = i
                       ELSE /\ PrintT("not sure of semantics of Pascal")
                            /\ i' = (CHOOSE x \in {} : FALSE)
                            /\ j' = j

IF k \leq r
            THEN /\ IF b[i] < b[j]
                       THEN /\ a' = [a EXCEPT ![k] = b[i]]
                            /\ i' = i + 1
                            /\ j' = j
                       ELSE /\ a' = [a EXCEPT ![k] = b[j]]
                            /\ j' = j - 1
                            /\ i' = i
                 /\ k' = k + 1
                 /\ pc' = "l7"
            ELSE /\ pc' = "l8"
                 /\ UNCHANGED << a, i, j, k >>

IF b[i] < b[j]
                       THEN /\ a' = [a EXCEPT ![k] = b[i]]
                            /\ i' = i + 1
                            /\ j' = j
                       ELSE /\ a' = [a EXCEPT ![k] = b[j]]
                            /\ j' = j - 1
                            /\ i' = i
